title: The Law Reports Act, 1875
preamble: Preamble [Repealed by the Government of India (Adaptation of Indian Laws) Order, 1937.]

sections.title: Short title
sections.text: 1. This Act may be called the Law Reports Act, 1875 .

sections.title: Local extent
sections.text: It extends to the whole of 1 [Bangladesh].

sections.title: Commencement
sections.text: 2 [And it shall come into force at once].

sections.title: [Repealed ]
sections.text: 2. [Repealed by the Repealing Act, 1876 (Act No. XII of 1876).]

sections.title:
Authority given only to authorized
reports
sections.text: 3. No Court shall be bound to hear cited, or shall receive or treat as an authority binding on it, the report of any case decided 3 [* * *] by 4 [the Supreme Court], other than a report published under the authority of 5 [Government].

sections.title:
Authority
of judicial
decisions
sections.text: 4. Nothing herein contained shall be construed to give to any judicial decision any further or other authority than it would have had if this Act had not been passed.
